name: Conservation Partners Legacy (CPL) Grant Program
summary: Minnesota state matching grants for nonprofits and public bodies that restore, enhance or protect prairies, wetlands, forests and fish and wildlife habitat. In fiscal year 2027 all money goes to projects in the Twin Cities metro area and the state's largest cities.

geography.label: Minnesota: the seven-county Twin Cities metro area, Duluth, Rochester and St. Cloud

reporting: Grantees file an accomplishment report by 31 December of each year the grant is active, updated cumulatively until it becomes the final report, and prepare an ecological restoration and management plan with the first payment request.

calls.label: FY2027 Expedited Conservation Projects, Round 2

status.quote: Open continuously through May 10, 2027, or until funds run out, whichever comes first.

calls.note: Grants of $5,000 to $75,000 for restoration and enhancement only. Later rounds close on 11 January, 8 March and 10 May 2027, or when funds run out.

calls.label: FY2027 Metro grants, Round 2

status.quote: January 1, 2027: Round 2 application system opens if funds remain.

opens.quote: January 1, 2027: Round 2 application system opens if funds remain.

calls.note: Held only if funds remain after Round 1.

applicant_types.quote: Registered 501 c(3) nonprofit organizations and government entities are eligible for CPL funding. Private individuals and for-profit organizations may not apply.

geography.quote: Projects must be located within the 7- county metro area or within city limits of cities with a population of 50,000 or greater (Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud).

access.quote: Applications for Round 1 of the Metro and Expedited Conservation Project (ECP) grant cycles will be accepted online beginning August 1, 2026.

window.quote: Completed applications will be pulled for review every two months on the following days at 4:00 pm

amount.quote: provide competitive matching grants from $5,000 up to $500,000 to local, regional, state, and national non-profit organizations and government entities

co_finance_required.quote: A 10% match of non-state funds is required for all grants.

reporting.quote: Accomplishment Reports must be submitted by December 31 of each year that the grant is active. The Accomplishment Report form is designed to be cumulative and updated each year until it becomes the Final Report.
